title: Gaia Provenance Sidecar Ledger
description: Sidecar ledger written at ingest linking a registry node back to its upstream markers: discovery packet, intake batch, intake issue, crawler origin, and evidence seed. Stored at registry/provenance/<skill-id>.json. Separate from the node (no skill.schema.json change) so the node stays clean (RFC3 §3.1, GAP10 + GAP11). The status ladder (RFC3 §3.4, GAP6/GAP7) is codified here, not on the node status enum.

skillId.description: The ingested skill id this ledger belongs to (contributor/slug for named skills, or a generic id).

genericSkillRef.description: The generic skill id this named skill points at via genericSkillRef, when applicable.

discoveryPacket.description: Repo-relative path to the discovery packet that produced this candidate (registry-for-review/discovery-packets/<candidate>.json).

discoveryPacketSha256.description: Canonical-JSON SHA256 of the discovery packet, matching the immutable intake handoff receipt.

intakeBatch.description: Repo-relative path to the intake batch (registry-for-review/skill-batches/<batch>.json).

intakeBatchId.description: Batch identity embedded in the intake issue, completing packet -> batch -> issue traceability.

intakeIssue.description: URL of the GitHub intake issue opened for this candidate.

crawlerOrigin.description: Crawler provenance carried forward from the discovery packet's source block (closes GAP11).

sourceLane.description: The discovery lane the candidate came from.

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical source URL of the candidate.

contentSha256.description: SHA256 of the fetched source content, carried from the packet.

evidenceSeed.description: Path to the RFC2 evidence-seed artifact (evidence/seeds/<skill-id>/).

ingestedAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time the skill was ingested into the tree and this ledger written.

status.description: Pipeline-position status ladder (RFC3 §3.4). Pre-ingest states have no node yet, so the ladder lives here, not on the node status enum. discovered -> review-ready -> intake-open -> evidence-seeded -> in-appraisal -> ingested; deferred/rejected are terminal off-ramps from the packet lifecycle.

timeline.description: Pre-ingest stage event log (RFC3 §3.2). Records discovery/intake-stage events that have no node/tree target before ingest. This is the ledger's own event log, NOT the node timeline; it is never a substitute for a node-timeline entry.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time of the stage event.

action.description: The pre-ingest stage action. discovered = candidate reached review-ready; intake_opened = intake issue opened.

notes.description: Human-readable context for the stage event.
